name: Default
shortDescription: CouchDB server preconfigured for the Self-hosted LiveSync Obsidian plugin, syncing vaults across desktop and mobile devices with optional end-to-end encryption.

alerts.message: There is no web app to open. In the Self-hosted LiveSync plugin, set the URI to https://<your domain>, sign in with COUCHDB_USER and COUCHDB_PASSWORD from the environment, pick a database name (the plugin creates it) and set an end-to-end encryption passphrase. These are CouchDB admin credentials and also unlock the Fauxton console at /_utils.
